title: Floating Loop PRD Task List
description: Structured dependency-aware user story backlog for Floating Loop autonomous execution.

description.description: Concise summary of the feature or initiative.

verifyCommand.description: Default shell command executed independently by the harness to verify each story (e.g., 'npm run typecheck && npm test').

defaultModel.description: Optional default model tier or identifier for stories without an explicit override.

maxRetriesPerStory.description: Maximum verification/repair retries allowed per story before halting or escalating.

description.description: User story narrative ('As a ..., I want ... so that ...').

acceptanceCriteria.description: Objective, verifiable criteria required to mark the story passing.

passes.description: Whether the story has been implemented and independently verified.

notes.description: Brief status notes or failure context persisted across iterations.

dependsOn.description: List of prerequisite story IDs that must pass before this story starts (enables parallel DAG wave execution).

verifyCommand.description: Story-specific verification command overriding the top-level verifyCommand.

hat.description: Specialized role overlay prompt for this story.

model.description: Optional per-story model override (e.g., 'flash', 'pro', or explicit model name).

filesHint.description: Optional file/directory hints to help isolate parallel worktree workers and avoid merge overlaps.
